summary: Stop GitHub issue-list sync before preflight refusal and report its errors (STARTER-603)

delivery.outcome: Issue-list runs sync the primary planfile backlog only after workspace preflight passes, only for tickets bound to the selected issues, never after a stopped run, and a failed or timed-out required sync stops the run with a persisted diagnostic.
nonGoals: Changing per-issue ledger synchronization inside run_ticket
Changing the issue snapshot, receipt resume or comment-replay semantics
Planfile sync implementation changes outside the koru CLI boundary

architecture.decision: Gate the backlog sync behind preflight_workspace, scope it via planfile --ticket flags bound to the selected issue URLs, skip it for empty/dry-run/stopped runs, and surface nonzero exits and timeouts as RuntimeError recorded in the persisted queue result.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch; the change is confined to batch sync ordering, scoping and error reporting.

validation.evidence: Dirty main, dry-run, empty list and stopped runs invoke zero backlog syncs; post-refusal no sync is attempted.
Sync commands carry --ticket ids bound to the selected issues only; nonzero exit and timeout stop the run with a persisted diagnostic instead of reporting completed.
